meanings.note: In idiom быть в шоколаде. Common masculine noun meaning 'chocolate' in everyday Russian.
In idiom быть в шоколаде. Common masculine noun meaning 'chocolate' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: You are golden!
A bar of milk chocolate.

examples.text: Всё, ты в шоколаде, проблем больше нет!
examples.trans: That is it, you are golden, there are no more problems!

meanings.note: Declinable masculine noun meaning 'shape', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Вот сладкие эклеры в виде длинных пальцев.
examples.trans: Here are sweet eclairs in the shape of long fingers.

examples.text: Посмотрите, Вика, наше праздничное меню уже готово.
examples.trans: Look, Vika, our festive menu is already ready.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine
Linking word: главное — это народ. Core Russian pron meaning 'this, that; it is' in everyday speech.

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'this, that; it is' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: That's mine.
And this is for you.
And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: This house.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.
